title: Fun with Flora and Fauna
desc: Spend Friday mornings and afternoons at Rock Creek Park learning about our wild and wonderful urban oasis ! Park Rangers will teach kids (and visitors of all ages) about the fantastic flora and fauna in the park.

title: Ranger Tours at the Old Stone House

title: Ranger Tours at Peirce Mill
desc: Step inside Peirce Mill, a rare surviving 19th-century gristmill in Rock Creek Park, and discover how waterpower once supported daily life in Washington, DC. Built in the 1820s, the mill served local farmers by grinding grain into flour and cornmeal. On this guided tour, you’ll explore the mill’s machinery, including the waterwheel, gears, and millstones that brought the process to life. Learn how

title: Pop-up Program: Playtime in Colonial America
desc: It’s game on in colonial America . Unlike today where child’s play is dominated by factory toys and high-tech gadgets, colonial kids had to make do with what they had . Swing by our pop-up table at the Old Stone House . Stop in anytime from 2:00 pm to 4 :00 pm.

title: Abner Cloud House Tour
desc: Built in 1801 by Abner Cloud, Jr., the house is considered one of the finest examples of Federal architecture in Washington D.C. Pre-dating the construction of the C&O Canal, the home of Abner Cloud served as the center of the family farm and fishing business. Tour the Abner Cloud House and learn more about early 19th century farming, architecture, and the people who lived and worked on the proper

title: July Fourth, 1862—At Sea
desc: What was Independence Day like aboard a sailing ship in the middle of the ocean? Join us for the story of six-year-old Sara Delano, future mother of Franklin D. title: The Unfinished America: A 250-Year Journey of Liberty and Economic Freedom
desc: Meet at the World War II Kiosk and join a National Park Service volunteer for an immersive 90-minute walking tour exploring the evolution of individual liberty and economic freedom while visiting several National Mall monuments and memorials. title: Books and Beyond with a Ranger at Peirce Barn
desc: If you have a little one to take care of and are looking for something fun to do, come read and sing all about nature with a park ranger! This program includes nature books, animal puppets, body movements, and songs. Due to high summer temperatures, we will only be doing this program at Peirce Mill Barn for the month of August.
